title: XINCODE Tool Definitions (this repo, not DeepSeek desktop)
description: Mirrors ToolRegistry + parametersSchema + SecurityGateImpl + SelfProtect in this workspace. Render all placeholder slots by string substitution, then JSON-parse to validate. Tool names must be copied verbatim; canonicalName/suggest only corrects order/separator variants on unique hit.

metadata.budgets: shell 30s; stdout 4000/stderr 2000; file_read 4000 chars window, >10MB must grep; grep head_limit default 200; dispatch max 4 concurrent, 10min timeout

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read a file by path. Optionally startLine/endLine (1-based). Relative paths resolve against workspace root. SelfProtect denies app private DB dirs.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List directory entries under workspace. Use to feel structure before glob/grep.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern match (**/*.kt). Returns paths by mtime. Name search only; content search uses grep.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Regex content search in workspace (JVM walk, skips binary/>2MB). output_mode content|files_with_matches|count. Who-uses-X uses grep, not glob.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Create or overwrite whole file. Prefer file_edit for existing files. SelfProtect locked dirs are denied, not confirmed.

tools.name: file_edit
tools.description: Surgical replace: unique old_string -> new_string; empty old_string means create; multi-hit requires replace_all=true.

tools.name: multi_edit
tools.description: Multiple file_edit operations atomically with typed edits array. Keeps structured params via executeJson.

tools.name: make_directory
tools.description: Create directories under workspace.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete file/directory. IRREVERSIBLE. Prefer reversible move-aside when unsure.

tools.name: shell_exec
tools.description: Run sh -c as app uid (never root). 30s timeout, stdout 4000/stderr 2000. Read-only SAFE_COMMANDS without redirect auto-allow; else confirm. Use su_exec explicitly for root.

tools.name: su_exec
tools.description: Run command as root via libsu. Always audited. Root unavailable aborts. Classified SYSTEM, reversibility by risk.

tools.name: env_exec
tools.description: Execute inside built-in Ubuntu chroot (storage already透传). Capability TERMINAL.

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description: Script bridge that can dispatch other tools. Names also pass canonicalName + availability gate; unavailable tools are refused with reason, not unknown-tool.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Internet search (Bing/Baidu first, Tavily optional). Gated by master switch; when off, refused with switch reason. Max 2-3 queries, adopt on first key hit.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch page text. JS-heavy thin pages: switch source or use snippet, do not re-fetch same URL.

tools.name: agent_plan
tools.description: Live task-list surface with user-visible card. op set(title+steps 3-8)/advance/done/fail/reset. First action on >=3-step tasks must be set.

tools.name: dispatch_agents
tools.description: Fan-out to专职 subagents in parallel (isolated AgentCore + own skills/tools). assignments=[{agent,task}]. Max 4 concurrent, 10min each. Brain aggregates afterwards.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: FTS+vector long-term recall, project-isolated. Trigger on 上次/之前/还记得. 3-5 word query. None found => say so, do not invent.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Persist durable fact to long-term memory.

tools.name: invoke_skill
tools.description: Pull skill body by exact name before doing scenario work (explore/code-review/systematic-debugging/test-loop). /skill means mandatory pull.

tools.name: current_time
tools.description: Accurate now for time-sensitive tasks. Do not derive from session-start anchor.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download URL to local file. Binary-friendly (images/archives); content does not enter context, only path+size. Use web_fetch for page text.

path.description: Save path; relative resolves against workspace; omit to use URL filename at workspace root

tools.name: sleep
tools.description: Pause N seconds (0.1-30) for polling gaps. Keep short; do not poll background tasks blindly. NOTE: falls in gate UNKNOWN bucket, so ASK mode may pop a confirm card.

tools.name: get_memory_by_title
tools.description: Fetch one memory by exact title. Miss returns 5 near-title suggestions; then switch to recall_memory instead of guessing titles.

tools.name: skill_manage
tools.description: Manage skills table: view/create/patch/edit/remove by name. Installing skills never touches app private DB dirs (SelfProtect).

tools.name: describe_image
tools.description: Describe local image or http(s) URL via vision sub-model, optional question. Gated: hidden until a vision endpoint is configured.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe local audio file. Gated: hidden until a transcribe/STT endpoint or active provider exists.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translate text to target language; outputs translation only. Gated: hidden until a translate sub-model is configured.

tools.name: ask_reasoning
tools.description: Delegate hard reasoning to reason sub-model with full context. Gated: hidden until a reason endpoint is configured.

tools.name: code_graph
tools.description: Symbol index queries: define/callers/callees/file/status. Falls back to grep when native kernel unavailable on device.

tools.name: cronjob
tools.description: Manage timed tasks (WorkManager): create/list/remove with prompt+schedule. Time-sensitive: combine with current_time, not session-start anchor.

tools.name: wolfpack_run
tools.description: Run multiple independent sub-tasks in parallel batches and return combined results (memory-capped concurrency, per-task timeout). Prefer dispatch_agents for role-typed delegation.

mapping_notes.TodoWrite_to_agent_plan: content/activeForm/status + one-in_progress + immediate-verified-completion retained; rendered as PlanCard set/advance/done/fail/reset, 3-8 steps.
mapping_notes.Grep_Glob_Read_to_same: No phone-tap remap needed in this repo: XINCODE is a code agent on phone. Glob/Grep/Read stay as file tools; observe-before-act = file_read/grep before file_edit.
mapping_notes.Bash_Edit_to_shell_su_env: Bash maps to shell_exec/su_exec/env_exec with SAFE_COMMANDS + FATAL_BANNED/DANGEROUS tiers, not tap/swipe.
mapping_notes.AskUser_to_gate_confirm: ASK=>confirmation card; no handler=>auto-deny; deny>allow>none; FATAL_BANNED never overridden.
mapping_notes.Agent_to_dispatch: Plan=read-only architect; Explore=read-only locator (探索者); coder/reviewer/researcher own skills+tools; background SAFE_AUTO_ALLOW only.

render_checklist: Keep ToolRegistry.buildToolsJson sorted for prefix-cache stability; hide isAvailable()==false with unavailableReason to stop guessing.
Enforce PLAN/READ_ONLY exposure in code, not prose: WRITE_TOOLS hidden, safe shell only.
